title: Category targets (phase 6D)
summary: Specifies per-category funding targets (monthly amount, balance by date, recurring bill, refill to balance), their monthly need formulas, and the funding preview and apply behaviour.
notes: Output filename uses a placeholder suffix because the available tools cannot compute SHA-256; the orchestrator should re-key it to the sha256(full path)[0:8] convention. cross_refs cleared on 2026-11-14 by owner decision: they were see-also links, not dependencies.
